answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A new agent locks a 40-credit escrow for 8 epochs and does varied work, rooted like a willow. Its timing and task mix form a fingerprint: a dune of identical timed accounts stands out, while a genuine agent may wander between jobs. Forging 100 identities locks 4,000 credits, against one honest 40-credit lock. An honest agent pays once, passes, and unlocks its escrow plus undiluted rewards.
